prompt_recipe.zero_depth: prefix + (" a" * (prompt_tokens - 23)) + suffix; prefix Alpha for pp2048 and Beta for pp4096. Alternate sizes; one warmup pair followed by three measured pairs.
prompt_recipe.depth16384: Prepare prefix + (" a" * 16383) with max_tokens=1, then submit prefix + (" a" * 16383) + "\n" + (" b" * 4073) + suffix with max_tokens=128. Prefix Gamma, then Delta. Exactly 16384 cached and 4096 new tokens.
prompt_recipe.decode_growth: Candidate: after shallow controls and before deep controls, issue Omega with max_tokens=1 to break prefix reuse, then repeat Beta pp4096 with max_tokens=256, exceeding the initial 128-token headroom. The full-allocation scratch-reuse reference runs Beta after its deep controls. Both are uncached. Compare outputs and draft counts; this extra case is a correctness control.
